assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: An angle alpha at A with points T_B and T_C at distance s from A on its sides; the blue circle with centre J touches both sides at T_B and T_C, the red dashed circle with centre A has radius h, and the line BC touches both circles, with the red altitude h from A to BC.

difficulty_rationale: The decisive idea, that the excircle touches the sides of the angle at distance s from A, is hard to spot; the existence analysis needs common tangents of two circles.
